One way we can help meet temporal needs is by donatingfast offerings.

All adult Church members and youth turning 14 or older can serve as someone else’s ministering brother or sister. This way, each member can help care for and fellowship but is also being cared for and fellowshipped themselves. Seechapter 21of theGeneral Handbookfor more information.
